title: apa-3seq-lapa pipeline parameters
description: 3'-end sequencing with UMIs: adapter trimming, demultiplexing, UMI extraction, STAR alignment, internal-priming filter, UMI deduplication and polyA site calling with LAPA for a single pool.

reads.description: Paired-end FASTQ pattern of the pool
reads.help_text: One quoted glob pattern that matches R1 and R2 of the pool, for example '/path/TDP43_KD_POOL_1_{1,2}.fq.gz'. It must contain {1,2} or a wildcard.

barcodes.help_text: FASTA with one barcode per sample. The sequence names are the sample names, e.g. R1_NT, R2_TDP43. The condition is what follows 'R<n>_'.

star_index.help_text: Index generated with a STAR version compatible with the one in the container (2.7.4a or newer for 2.7.x).

genome_fasta.help_text: Reference genome FASTA (e.g. GRCh38 primary assembly). Its .fai index must be next to it (samtools faidx).

genome_sizes.help_text: Two-column chrom.sizes file used by bedtools slop and LAPA.

lapa_gtf.help_text: GTF used by LAPA. It must contain three_prime_utr features (see gencode_utr_fix).

gtf_names.description: GTF used only for gene names
gtf_names.help_text: Optional. Defaults to lapa_gtf. Only used by the differential analysis step.

pool_name.help_text: Prefix of the differential analysis outputs and the LAPA dataset name when lapa_dataset is 'single'.

umi_pattern.help_text: umi_tools extract --bc-pattern. One N per UMI nucleotide at the 5' end of R1.

treatment.help_text: Only needed when run_analysis is true. Must match the condition in the barcode names, e.g. TDP43 or N325S.

control.help_text: Only needed when run_analysis is true. Must match the condition in the barcode names, e.g. NT or WT.

outdir.help_text: Directory that will contain the BAMs, LAPA output, QC reports and logs.

publish_mode.help_text: Nextflow publishDir mode. 'copy' duplicates files, 'symlink' saves disk space but links point to the work directory.

advanced_options.title: Advanced Options
advanced_options.description: Trimming, internal priming and LAPA parameters.

ip_window.help_text: Window of nucleotides checked for adenosines, both at the 3' end of the read and downstream in the genome.

ip_max_a.description: Maximum number of A in the window
ip_max_a.help_text: Reads with more than this number of A in the window are removed.

ip_max_run.help_text: Reads with a longer run of consecutive A are removed.

lapa_dataset.description: Dataset column written to the LAPA alignment CSV
lapa_dataset.help_text: 'condition' uses the condition of each sample (NT, TDP43...) as dataset; 'single' puts all samples in one dataset.

lapa_clusters_file.help_text: File name expected inside lapa_out after running LAPA.

differential_analysis_options.title: Differential Analysis Options
differential_analysis_options.description: Only used when run_analysis is true.

apa_analysis.description: Run the differential polyA site analysis
apa_analysis.help_text: Filters, Fisher test, proximal/distal pairing and volcano plot. Requires treatment and control.

min_mean.description: Minimum mean count in one condition

min_usage.description: Minimum mean usage in one condition (fraction)

require_detected_all.description: Require counts > 0 in all samples of one condition

delta.description: Minimum absolute change in distal usage

highlight.description: Gene to highlight in the volcano plot
